messages.body_plain:
Hi Chris,

>From what I see looking at the log files, it appears that the instance is running out of memory. The interactive version only works for quite small datasets (i.e. 1000ish cells). How big is the dataset you're using?

You may need to switch to the non-interactive version in R.

Best,
Hannah
